name: Six Senses Samui
positioning: A villa resort on a secluded headland at the northern tip of Koh Samui, with views across the Gulf of Thailand
best_for: Couples wanting a private pool villa with ocean views
Families or groups needing multi-bedroom villas

facts.text: The resort is in Baan Plai Laem, Bophut, Koh Samui.
The villas blend into the natural landscape with views across the Gulf of Thailand.
Villas are hidden away in the natural vegetation.
Guests can choose villas on the hill or right on the ocean.
Larger options include the two-bedroom Ocean Retreat and three-bedroom Beach Reserve.
Drift at the Beach has a beach club pool.
From Swimming on the Hill guests can watch the sun set over palm-clustered islands.
A guided sustainability walk visits Farm on the Hill and Earth Lab.
At Farm on the Hill guests can feed the goats and chickens and gather freshly laid eggs for breakfast.
Dining by the Edge offers an intimate dining experience with Thai flavors.

highlights.text: The resort is perched on a secluded headland at the northern tip of Koh Samui.
All villas offer ocean or tropical landscape views, and most have private pools.
At Six Senses Spa, private treatment salas overlook a rock-fringed bay.
From Swimming on the Hill guests can watch the sun set over palm-clustered islands.

considerations.text: Not every villa has a private pool, and views are of the ocean or the tropical landscape depending on the villa.
Villas are either on the hill or right on the ocean, so choose the location that suits you.
